title: Controls
description: Other controls laid out like text fields: an InputGroup with $gap="none" and a text InputSlot prefix that focuses the input on click, a ComboboxSelect in a ComboboxField with ComboboxSelectLabel and ComboboxDescription, and an Input rendered as a textarea with maxLength. Use it when a form mixes a prefixed URL input, a select, and a multiline field that share the same label and hint layout.
